name: Legged robot (quadruped)
description: Walking robot whose locomotion controller drives one actuator per joint (e.g. ANYmal D: 4 legs x 3 joints).

CHK-CONTROLLER-LOGS.question: Retrieve the locomotion controller and robot state-machine log (mode changes, protective stops, controller switches) for this mission
CHK-CONTROLLER-LOGS.why: A controller switch, protective stop or e-stop at the onset is recorded only by the robot's own software log.
tools: Robot software log (e.g. ANYmal state machine / ROS bag of controller topics)

CHK-NETWORK-LOGS.question: Export the operator link logs (Wi-Fi or mesh signal, joystick message rate) for the mission

CHK-ONSITE-ACTUATOR.question: Inspect the joint drive named in the evidence: drive error register, temperature, encoder and cabling, then the leg it moves
CHK-ONSITE-ACTUATOR.why: A joint that stops following its commands is first a drive question (drive fault, encoder, temperature derating), then a mechanical one (leg, foot, obstruction).

CHK-CLOCK-OFFSET.question: Establish the clock offset between the operator console and the robot's onboard computers
CHK-CLOCK-OFFSET.why: Without a bounded offset between the operator console and the robot's clocks, delays between a command sent and the robot's motion cannot be measured.

CHK-CONFIRM-CONTEXT.question: Confirm the robot model, onboard software release and locomotion controller version for this mission

CHK-REPRODUCE.question: Replay the recorded commands on the same robot on a test stand or in simulation, on the same terrain type

routine_events.why: all 12 joint drives switched between freeze (1) and position control (13) together: the robot standing up or lying down (ANYdrive command modes)
all 12 joint drives changed status word together with that command-mode switch

points.label: Operator joystick or mission command
points.if_missing: The operator's own inputs are not recorded: whether a person commanded the change cannot be read.

points.label: Operator and mission link
points.if_missing: The link between operator and machine is not measured: delays or losses on it cannot be read.

points.label: Locomotion controller (mode, gait, setpoints)
points.if_missing: The controller's own mode, configuration and messages are not recorded.

points.label: Joint commands the controller sends
points.if_missing: The controller's output commands are not recorded.

points.label: Joint drives (measured position and torque)
points.if_missing: No actuator feedback is recorded: whether an actuator did what it was commanded cannot be read.

points.label: Body motion (velocity, attitude)
points.if_missing: The machine's motion is not measured.

mechanisms.label: Operator command
mechanisms.needs: The operator's inputs and the console log at the onset

mechanisms.label: Command link delay or loss
mechanisms.needs: Link quality and command timing records for the window

mechanisms.label: Controller behaviour (mode change, configuration, failsafe or control logic)
mechanisms.needs: The controller's own mode, event and configuration log at the onset

mechanisms.label: Joint drive (drive fault, encoder, temperature derating): joint not following its command
mechanisms.needs: The drive's status and error log, or an inspection of the drive

mechanisms.label: Leg, foot, terrain or load: joints follow commands but the body does not move as expected
mechanisms.needs: Actuator feedback alongside the motion, or an inspection of the mechanism

mechanisms.label: Measurement error: the machine moved normally but a sensor reported otherwise
mechanisms.needs: A second, independent measurement of the same motion
